env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A comptime generic that nothing instantiates is dropped from the output
# from its own func keyword, whatever stands between that keyword and the
# name: a block comment, a line comment or a line break. The module runs
# natively, ejects without the dropped functions, and the ejected module
# builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints
# the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep 'unused' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/comptimetparamboundary

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func /*c*/ unusedBlock[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func // c
unusedLine[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func
unusedBreak[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func /*c*/ /*d*/ unusedBoth /*e*/ [T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("ok")
}
